name: University of Vienna
summary: Vienna's public general university: bachelor's taught in German, plus one in English, Mathematical Foundations of Data Science.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points (not an IB Certificate), including maths and a foreign language, three subjects at HL. German-taught bachelor's need German C1; IB German counts only as A2.

programmes.name: Mathematical Foundations of Data Science
programmes.ib: No German needed; English B2 (an IB Diploma with English counts). Written aptitude test in Vienna, pass mark 50%; in 2026 you registered 2 March to 4 May.

notes: Degrees with an entrance test register in early spring: for 2026 entry the window was 2 March to 4 May 2026, and the 2027 window is not yet published.
International Legal Studies (LLB) and the Economics and Physics bachelor's teach partly in English but require German, so they are not listed here.
In u:space you give Switzerland as the country that issued an IB Diploma, wherever you took it; a German-English bilingual IB (GIB) counts as German C1.
